## Kollab — weekly KOL re-vet

**Env var:** set `KOLLAB_API_URL` on the n8n instance (base URL of the Kollab API,
no trailing slash — e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8000`). The *Fetch shortlist* node calls
`$env.KOLLAB_API_URL + /api/shortlist`.

**Two triggers, one flow.** The weekly cron (Mon 08:00 Asia/Bangkok — workflow
timezone) is production; the webhook exists so a demo can fire the identical run
on camera without waiting for Monday: `GET <n8n-host>/webhook/kollab-revet`.
Use the Production URL (workflow active) — the snapshot lives in workflow static
data, which only persists across production executions.

**Slack:** open *Slack alert* and attach the agency workspace credential
(bot token, `chat:write`, bot invited to the channel). Until then the node shows a
credential warning — everything upstream still runs.
